observation.visible_scene: A night-sky fireworks display shown as a short temporal excerpt. Against a black background, several bursts appear, expand, glitter, and fade in sequence, while a plume of smoke lingers and drifts at the lower-left edge.
visible_changes: At the start a small white-gold starburst is already partly expanded near the bottom-center, with a few faint sparks scattered above.
A bright magenta/purple burst blooms at upper-left and grows into a large spherical shell of pink streaks whose tips become glowing dots; the gold burst below remains and overlaps it.
The pink shell's continuous streaks dim into discrete dots as it fades, leaving the gold burst as the brighter element.
A new white-gold burst erupts at left-center and expands into a dense glittering starburst, accompanied by many small white sub-burst clusters spreading to the right and downward.
The glittering field shifts in hue from gold/white to green, with green sparkling dots dominating the left and center while isolated red/magenta dots persist on the right.
In the final frames the green dots thin out, the scene darkens, and a single bright white dot drifts downward-right while a red dot remains upper-right.
The lower-left smoke plume is present throughout, growing and taking on pink then green tints as it reflects the bursts.
outside_clip_unknowns: The launch points, mortar positions, and any bursts that began before the first frame or continue after the last.
Whether the magenta, gold, and green phases are separate shells or color changes within one shell.
The total duration and conclusion of the display.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is hard to confirm because the background is uniformly black; apparent shifts are treated as firework movement rather than panning.
The exact count of distinct shells and the cause of color transitions (composition vs. fading trails) cannot be determined from the frames alone.
